children: Trader Bonk Guy said he is not loyal to PONS or any other position or community. According to ChainCatcher, he said he has never been paid by the PONS team and is not a member of the project team, so his holdings and support for PONS should not be interpreted as loyalty to the project.

Bonk Guy said he is bullish on PONS because of the fairness he believes the token represents and because he sees it as offering on-chain traders a chance to create generational wealth. He described PONS as a trade that has not yet fully played out and said its market value could still reach billions of dollars, regardless of whether the market currently agrees.

He added that the same principle applies to his other holdings: he is first and foremost a trader, not loyal to any token or community, and will only choose trades he believes offer the most asymmetric risk-reward profile.

title: Bonk Guy Says He Is Not Loyal to PONS or Any Token Community
